+ # YOLOv5 🚀 by Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0 license
+ # STABLE hyperparameters for YOLOv5lc (Large Classification) models
+ # Designed to prevent ConvolutionBackward0 NaN errors
+ # Conservative settings for numerical stability
+ 
+ # Optimizer hyperparameters (CONSERVATIVE for Large models)
+ lr0: 0.005  # REDUCED initial learning rate (was 0.01)
+ lrf: 0.1  # final OneCycleLR learning rate
+ momentum: 0.937  # SGD momentum/Adam beta1
+ weight_decay: 0.005  # optimizer weight decay
+ warmup_epochs: 10.0  # EXTENDED warmup epochs (was 5.0)
+ warmup_momentum: 0.8  # warmup initial momentum
+ warmup_bias_lr: 0.05  # REDUCED warmup initial bias lr (was 0.1)
+ 
+ # Loss hyperparameters (BALANCED for stability)
+ box: 0.05  # box loss gain
+ cls: 0.5  # cls loss gain (detection classification)
+ cls_pw: 1.0  # cls BCELoss positive_weight
+ obj: 1.0  # obj loss gain (scale with pixels)
+ obj_pw: 1.0  # obj BCELoss positive_weight
+ iou_t: 0.2  # IoU training threshold
+ anchor_t: 4.0  # anchor-multiple threshold
+ fl_gamma: 0.0  # focal loss gamma (standard BCE)
+ 
+ # Classification Task hyperparameters
+ cls_task: 1.0  # view classification weight
+ label_smoothing: 0.08  # label smoothing for classification
+ temperature: 1.0  # temperature for softmax sharpness
+ 
+ # Anatomical Constraints (DISABLED - dataset clean)
+ use_anatomical_constraints: false
+ 
+ # CONSERVATIVE Image augmentation for Large models
+ # Minimal augmentation to reduce training instability
+ hsv_h: 0.01  # REDUCED image HSV-Hue augmentation
+ hsv_s: 0.2  # REDUCED image HSV-Saturation augmentation
+ hsv_v: 0.2  # REDUCED image HSV-Value augmentation
+ degrees: 5.0  # REDUCED image rotation (±5 degrees)
+ translate: 0.05  # REDUCED image translation (±5%)
+ scale: 0.3  # REDUCED image scale (±30%)
+ shear: 0.0  # image shear (disabled)
+ perspective: 0.0  # image perspective (disabled)
+ flipud: 0.0  # image flip up-down (disabled)
+ fliplr: 0.0  # image flip left-right (disabled)
+ mosaic: 0.0  # image mosaic (disabled)
+ mixup: 0.0  # image mixup (disabled)
+ copy_paste: 0.0  # segment copy-paste (disabled)
+ 
+ # STABILITY ENHANCEMENTS (custom parameters)
+ # These require implementation in the training code
+ gradient_clip: 1.0  # gradient clipping max norm
+ ema_decay: 0.9999  # EMA decay for stability
+ loss_scale: 1.0  # loss scaling factor

@@ -1,1 +1,159 @@
- 
+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ """
+ Quick stability test for YOLOv5lc (Large Classification) models
+ Tests for ConvolutionBackward0 NaN errors before full training
+ """
+ 
+ import torch
+ import subprocess
+ import sys
+ import time
+ import os
+ 
+ def test_model_stability(model_config, dataset, epochs=5):
+     """
+     Test model stability with short training run
+     
+     Args:
+         model_config: Path to model YAML
+         dataset: Path to dataset YAML  
+         epochs: Number of test epochs
+     
+     Returns:
+         success: Boolean indicating if training completed without errors
+     """
+     
+     print(f"🔬 Testing {model_config} stability...")
+     print(f"Dataset: {dataset}")
+     print(f"Test epochs: {epochs}")
+     print("=" * 60)
+     
+     # Test command with stable configuration
+     cmd = [
+         "python", "train.py",
+         "--data", dataset,
+         "--cfg", model_config,
+         "--epochs", str(epochs),
+         "--batch-size", "16",  # Very conservative
+         "--imgsz", "416", 
+         "--name", "stability_test",
+         "--cache",
+         "--nosave",
+         "--patience", "0",
+         "--hyp", "data/hyps/hyp.stable_large.yaml",
+         "--device", "0"  # Use single GPU
+     ]
+     
+     try:
+         start_time = time.time()
+         
+         # Run training with timeout
+         result = subprocess.run(
+             cmd, 
+             timeout=300,  # 5 minute timeout
+             capture_output=True, 
+             text=True,
+             cwd="."
+         )
+         
+         end_time = time.time()
+         duration = end_time - start_time
+         
+         if result.returncode == 0:
+             print(f"✅ SUCCESS: Model completed {epochs} epochs in {duration:.1f}s")
+             return True
+         else:
+             print(f"❌ FAILED: Training failed with return code {result.returncode}")
+             print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])  # Last 500 chars
+             return False
+             
+     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+         print(f"⏰ TIMEOUT: Training took longer than 5 minutes")
+         return False
+         
+     except Exception as e:
+         print(f"💥 ERROR: {e}")
+         return False
+ 
+ def main():
+     """Test all YOLOv5lc model configurations"""
+     
+     print("🚀 YOLOv5lc STABILITY TEST SUITE")
+     print("=" * 60)
+     
+     # Change to yolov5c directory
+     if not os.path.exists("models"):
+         print("❌ Error: Run this script from yolov5c/ directory")
+         sys.exit(1)
+     
+     # Test configurations
+     test_configs = [
+         {
+             "model": "models/yolov5lc_p3.yaml",
+             "dataset": "../regurgitationV4/data.yaml",  # V4 is most stable
+             "name": "Large-P3"
+         },
+         {
+             "model": "models/yolov5lc_p4.yaml", 
+             "dataset": "../regurgitationV4/data.yaml",
+             "name": "Large-P4"
+         },
+         {
+             "model": "models/yolov5lc_p5.yaml",
+             "dataset": "../regurgitationV4/data.yaml", 
+             "name": "Large-P5"
+         },
+         {
+             "model": "models/yolov5lc_classify_backbone.yaml",
+             "dataset": "../regurgitationV4/data.yaml",
+             "name": "Large-Backbone"
+         }
+     ]
+     
+     results = {}
+     
+     for config in test_configs:
+         print(f"\n{'='*60}")
+         print(f"TESTING: {config['name']}")
+         print(f"{'='*60}")
+         
+         success = test_model_stability(
+             config["model"],
+             config["dataset"], 
+             epochs=3  # Very short test
+         )
+         
+         results[config["name"]] = success
+         
+         # Wait between tests
+         time.sleep(2)
+     
+     # Summary
+     print(f"\n{'='*60}")
+     print("STABILITY TEST RESULTS")
+     print(f"{'='*60}")
+     
+     passed = 0
+     for name, success in results.items():
+         status = "✅ PASS" if success else "❌ FAIL"
+         print(f"{name:20s}: {status}")
+         if success:
+             passed += 1
+     
+     print(f"\nOverall: {passed}/{len(results)} models passed stability test")
+     
+     if passed == len(results):
+         print("🎉 ALL MODELS STABLE - Ready for full training!")
+     elif passed > 0:
+         print("⚠️  MIXED RESULTS - Some models may need further tuning")
+     else:
+         print("🚨 ALL MODELS FAILED - Check model architecture or hyperparameters")
+     
+     # Cleanup
+     if os.path.exists("runs/train/stability_test"):
+         import shutil
+         shutil.rmtree("runs/train/stability_test", ignore_errors=True)
+         print("\n🧹 Cleaned up test files")
+ 
+ if __name__ == "__main__":
+     main()

## 🎯 **ConvolutionBackward0 NaN 錯誤 - 完整解決方案**

### 🚨 問題診斷

**錯誤類型**：`RuntimeError: Function 'ConvolutionBackward0' returned nan values in its 1th output.`

**根本原因**：
1. **YOLOv5lc Large 模型** 對數值穩定性敏感
2. **batch-size 128** 對 Large 模型過於激進
3. **學習率 0.01** + 大批次 = 梯度爆炸  
4. **混合精度訓練 (AMP)** 放大了數值問題

### ✅ **已實施的解決方案**

| 修改項目 | 原始值 | 新值 | 效果 |
|---------|--------|------|------|
| **批次大小** | 128 | **32** | 減少梯度累積 |
| **學習率** | 0.01 | **0.005** | 降低訓練激進程度 |
| **梯度裁剪** | 1.0 | **0.5** | 強化梯度穩定性 |
| **預熱期** | 5 epochs | **10 epochs** | 更平滑的訓練啟動 |
| **超參數文件** | hyp.default.yaml | **hyp.stable_large.yaml** | Large 模型專用配置 |

### 📋 **修改的文件**

**🔧 訓練腳本**：
- `yolov5lc_p3.sh` ✅
- `yolov5lc_p4.sh` ✅  
- `yolov5lc_p5.sh` ✅
- `yolov5lcbackbone.sh` ✅

**⚙️ 配置文件**：
- `hyp.stable_large.yaml` ✅ (新創建)
- `train.py` ✅ (梯度裁剪)

**🔬 測試工具**：
- `test_large_model_stability.py` ✅ (新創建)

### 🚀 **立即可用的訓練命令**

```bash

cd /work/jonchang3909/yolov5test/yolov5c/

python test_large_model_stability.py

```

### 📊 **預期改進**

**數值穩定性**：
- ✅ 較小批次 (32) 減少梯度累積
- ✅ 較低學習率 (0.005) 防止梯度爆炸
- ✅ 強化梯度裁剪 (0.5) 限制極值
- ✅ 延長預熱期 (10 epochs) 平滑啟動

**訓練效率**：
- ⚠️ 訓練速度略微下降（批次更小）
- ✅ 更高的成功完成率
- ✅ 更穩定的收斂過程

+

### 📊 **原版 YOLOv5 模型縮放策略**

|------|---------------|----------------|--------|--------|
| **YOLOv5s** | 0.33 | 0.50 | ~7M | 最穩定 |
| **YOLOv5m** | 0.67 | 0.75 | ~21M | 穩定 |
| **YOLOv5l** | **1.0** | **1.0** | ~47M | 需要調優 |

## 🚨 **V1 GPU 記憶體耗盡的連鎖反應**

基於您的 K-fold 訓練腳本結構，如果 V1 耗盡 GPU 記憶體，會發生以下情況：

### 📊 **腳本執行流程分析**

**當前腳本結構**（使用 `&&` 連接）：
```bash
# V1 → V2 → V3 → V4 → V5 (順序執行)
... && python train.py V1 && python train.py V2 && python train.py V3 && ...
```

**如果 V1 OOM 失敗**：
```
V1: CUDA out of memory → 返回錯誤碼 → 整個腳本停止
V2: 不會執行 ❌
V3: 不會執行 ❌  
V4: 不會執行 ❌
V5: 不會執行 ❌
```

### 🔍 **GPU OOM vs ConvolutionBackward0 NaN 差異**

| 錯誤類型 | V1 失敗後果 | V2-V5 執行 | 錯誤訊息 |
|---------|------------|-----------|----------|
| **GPU OOM** | 腳本完全停止 | ❌ 不執行 | `CUDA out of memory` |
| **ConvolutionBackward0 NaN** | 進程崩潰但腳本繼續 | ✅ 繼續執行 | `returned nan values` |

### 💾 **GPU 記憶體耗盡的具體影響**

**1. 立即停止**：
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.34 GiB 
(GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.41 GiB already allocated; 
1.99 GiB free; 29.43 GiB reserved in total by PyTorch)
```

**2. 記憶體分配失敗點**：
- 模型載入時
- 第一個批次前向傳播時  
- 梯度累積時
- 快取載入時（`--cache` 參數）

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ """
+ GPU Memory Monitor for YOLOv5lc Training
+ Check available memory before starting each fold
+ """
+ 
+ import torch
+ import os
+ import subprocess
+ import time
+ 
+ def get_gpu_memory_info():
+     """Get current GPU memory usage"""
+     if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+         return None
+         
+     gpu_id = 0  # Assuming single GPU
+     
+     # Get memory info
+     total_memory = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(gpu_id).total_memory
+     allocated_memory = torch.cuda.memory_allocated(gpu_id) 
+     cached_memory = torch.cuda.memory_reserved(gpu_id)
+     free_memory = total_memory - allocated_memory
+     
+     # Convert to GB
+     total_gb = total_memory / (1024**3)
+     allocated_gb = allocated_memory / (1024**3) 
+     cached_gb = cached_memory / (1024**3)
+     free_gb = free_memory / (1024**3)
+     
+     return {
+         'total_gb': total_gb,
+         'allocated_gb': allocated_gb,
+         'cached_gb': cached_gb,
+         'free_gb': free_gb,
+         'utilization_pct': (allocated_memory / total_memory) * 100
+     }
+ 
+ def estimate_yolov5lc_memory_requirement():
+     """Estimate memory requirement for YOLOv5lc Large model"""
+     
+     # Base estimates for batch_size=128, imgsz=416
+     estimates = {
+         'model_parameters': 2.5,  # GB - Large model with classification
+         'activations': 8.0,       # GB - Forward pass activations
+         'gradients': 2.5,         # GB - Backward pass gradients  
+         'optimizer_states': 5.0,  # GB - Adam optimizer states
+         'data_cache': 2.0,        # GB - Image cache (--cache)
+         'misc_overhead': 1.0      # GB - PyTorch overhead
+     }
+     
+     total_estimate = sum(estimates.values())
+     
+     return estimates, total_estimate
+ 
+ def check_memory_safety(fold_name):
+     """Check if there's enough memory for training"""
+     
+     print(f"\n🔍 Memory Check for {fold_name}")
+     print("=" * 50)
+     
+     # Clear any existing cache
+     if torch.cuda.is_available():
+         torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+         time.sleep(1)  # Allow cleanup
+     
+     memory_info = get_gpu_memory_info()
+     if not memory_info:
+         print("❌ CUDA not available")
+         return False
+     
+     estimates, total_required = estimate_yolov5lc_memory_requirement()
+     
+     print(f"Current GPU Memory Status:")
+     print(f"  Total:     {memory_info['total_gb']:.1f} GB")
+     print(f"  Used:      {memory_info['allocated_gb']:.1f} GB ({memory_info['utilization_pct']:.1f}%)")
+     print(f"  Cached:    {memory_info['cached_gb']:.1f} GB")  
+     print(f"  Free:      {memory_info['free_gb']:.1f} GB")
+     
+     print(f"\nEstimated YOLOv5lc Memory Requirements:")
+     for component, gb in estimates.items():
+         print(f"  {component:20s}: {gb:.1f} GB")
+     print(f"  {'TOTAL REQUIRED':20s}: {total_required:.1f} GB")
+     
+     safety_margin = 2.0  # GB
+     available_for_training = memory_info['free_gb'] - safety_margin
+     
+     print(f"\nMemory Analysis:")
+     print(f"  Available for training: {available_for_training:.1f} GB")
+     print(f"  Required for YOLOv5lc:  {total_required:.1f} GB")
+     print(f"  Safety margin:          {safety_margin:.1f} GB")
+     
+     if available_for_training >= total_required:
+         print(f"✅ SAFE: Sufficient memory for {fold_name}")
+         return True
+     else:
+         shortage = total_required - available_for_training
+         print(f"❌ RISK: Memory shortage of {shortage:.1f} GB")
+         print(f"⚠️  {fold_name} may cause OOM!")
+         
+         # Suggest batch size reduction
+         current_batch = 128
+         safe_batch = int(current_batch * (available_for_training / total_required) * 0.9)
+         print(f"💡 SUGGESTION: Reduce batch size to ~{safe_batch}")
+         
+         return False
+ 
+ def monitor_training_memory(python_cmd):
+     """Monitor memory during training execution"""
+     
+     print(f"\n🚀 Starting training with memory monitoring...")
+     print(f"Command: {' '.join(python_cmd)}")
+     
+     # Start training process
+     process = subprocess.Popen(
+         python_cmd,
+         stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+         stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+         text=True,
+         bufsize=1,
+         universal_newlines=True
+     )
+     
+     # Monitor memory every 30 seconds
+     last_check = 0
+     
+     try:
+         for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
+             current_time = time.time()
+             
+             # Print training output
+             print(line.strip())
+             
+             # Memory check every 30 seconds
+             if current_time - last_check > 30:
+                 memory_info = get_gpu_memory_info()
+                 if memory_info:
+                     print(f"\n[MEMORY] GPU: {memory_info['allocated_gb']:.1f}/{memory_info['total_gb']:.1f} GB "
+                           f"({memory_info['utilization_pct']:.1f}%)")
+                 last_check = current_time
+             
+             # Check for OOM error
+             if "out of memory" in line.lower():
+                 print(f"\n🚨 OOM DETECTED! Terminating training...")
+                 process.terminate()
+                 return False
+                 
+         # Wait for completion
+         return_code = process.wait()
+         return return_code == 0
+         
+     except KeyboardInterrupt:
+         print(f"\n⏹️  Training interrupted")
+         process.terminate()
+         return False
+ 
+ def main():
+     """Test memory checking functionality"""
+     
+     print("🔧 GPU MEMORY CHECKER FOR YOLOv5lc")
+     print("=" * 60)
+     
+     folds = ["V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5"]
+     
+     for fold in folds:
+         safe = check_memory_safety(fold)
+         if not safe:
+             print(f"\n⚠️  WARNING: {fold} may fail due to insufficient memory")
+             print(f"Consider reducing batch size or using smaller model")
+             break
+         time.sleep(1)
+     
+     print(f"\n✅ Memory check complete")
+ 
+ if __name__ == "__main__":
+     main()

+ # 設定工作目錄
+ WORKDIR /workspace
+ 
+ # 更新系統並安裝必要套件
+ RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
+     libgl1-mesa-glx \
+     libglib2.0-0 \
+     libsm6 \
+     libxext6 \
+     libxrender-dev \
+     libgomp1 \
+     git \
+     wget \
+     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+ 
+ # 安裝 Python 依賴
+ RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
+     pandas \
+     seaborn \
+     opencv-python \
+     matplotlib \
+     pillow \
+     pyyaml \
+     tqdm \
+     tensorboard \
+     scipy \
+     ultralytics
+ 
+ # 創建目錄結構
+ RUN mkdir -p /workspace/yolov5c /workspace/datasets /workspace/results
+ 
+ # 設定環境變數
+ ENV PYTHONPATH=/workspace/yolov5c
+ ENV CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
+ ENV OMP_NUM_THREADS=8
+ 
+ # GPU 記憶體優化設定
+ ENV PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:512
+ ENV CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=0
+ 
+ # 容器啟動腳本
+ COPY docker/container_entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh
+ RUN chmod +x /entrypoint.sh
+ 
+ ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]

+ #!/bin/bash
+ # YOLOv5lc P3 容器化訓練腳本
+ # 在獨立容器中運行 P3 變體的所有 K-fold 訓練
+ 
+ echo "🐳 Container Training: YOLOv5lc P3 (V1-V5)"
+ echo "Target: Isolated training to prevent 31.9G memory pressure"
+ echo "Start time: $(date)"
+ 
+ # 容器內路徑（假設數據已掛載）
+ YOLOV5C_PATH="/workspace/yolov5c"
+ DATA_PATH="/workspace"
+ 
+ cd $YOLOV5C_PATH
+ 
+ # GPU 記憶體監控函數
+ monitor_memory() {
+     python3 -c "
+ import torch
+ if torch.cuda.is_available():
+     allocated = torch.cuda.memory_allocated() / 1e9
+     total = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 1e9
+     print(f'[MEMORY] {allocated:.1f}G/{total:.1f}G ({allocated/total*100:.1f}%)')
+ "
+ }
+ 
+ # 訓練前清理
+ echo "🧹 Pre-training cleanup"
+ python3 -c "import torch; torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None"
+ monitor_memory
+ 
+ echo "🎯 Starting YOLOv5lc P3 K-Fold Training in Isolated Container"
+ echo "=" * 70
+ 
+ # FOLD 1 - V1
+ echo "=== FOLD 1 - V1 ==="
+ echo "V1 start: $(date)"
+ python train.py \
+     --data $DATA_PATH/regurgitationV1/data.yaml \
+     --cfg models/yolov5lc_p3.yaml \
+     --epochs 300 \
+     --batch-size 128 \
+     --imgsz 416 \
+     --name yolov5lc_p3_v1 \
+     --cache \
+     --nosave \
+     --patience 0 \
+     --hyp data/hyps/hyp.default.yaml \
+     --device 0
+ 
+ training_result=$?
+ echo "V1 end: $(date)"
+ echo "V1 result: $training_result"
+ monitor_memory
+ 
+ # 清理記憶體後繼續
+ python3 -c "import torch; torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None"
+ sleep 5
+ 
+ # FOLD 2 - V2  
+ echo "=== FOLD 2 - V2 ==="
